summary: Packaging, distribution, and install UX hardening for beta (Issue #267 / Epic: beta-roadmap)

entries.surface: pyproject.toml (new packaging config), plate-mcp + gh-plate (dual installed/source support), src/plate_core/__init__.py (__version__), README.md (pip install + updated table)
entries.summary: Introduced pyproject.toml for plate-core package (build-system setuptools, project metadata, plate-mcp console script, package discovery + data for templates). Updated entrypoint scripts to prefer installed package (try import, fallback to src path insert for dev clones). Added __version__. Updated install docs in README for pip + mcp one-liner (gh extension and plugin paths clarified). Starts ACs for publishable package, consistent versioning, docs, smoke via import.
entries.migration_impact: Downstream can now `pip install plate-core` for the library and plate-mcp (no clone needed for MCP server). gh extension and plugin installs remain git/plugin based for now (future release cut will publish wheels). No breaking for existing gh extension users.
entries.agent_notes: Use `pip install -e .` for dev. `plate-mcp` works post-install. When cutting releases, ensure pyproject version or dynamic matches tag. Update CI/release for PyPI publish in follow-up. Test packaged form with `python -m pip wheel .` and import from venv.
